Messages.Author: Ron de Langen
Messages.Body:
I arleady know the answer to this one, but I need to print it out. So
here goes.

Question: I'm attempting to block a Camarilla exemplary, with a vampire
who has no blood on him, what happens? Can the vampire attempt to block
at all, even though he must burn a blood to attempt.?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He doesn't have to burn a blood "to attempt to block".
He burns a blood when he attempts to block.

(i.e., it isn't a cost that must be paid in order to attempt to block).

So, he attempts to block, burns a blood (ignoring "burn blood" effects
in excess of his current blood supply, as all vampires always do), and
the block attempts continues as normal.
